title: Book 6 · Thành thạo
description: Từ vựng nâng cao, độ chính xác cao (C1).

words.general_translation_vi: Đối địch, thù địch, nghịch lại, chống đối
meanings: Something that has an adverse effect can be harmful, dangerous, or unfavorable.
examples: I worry that the tornado will have an adverse effect on the farm.

words.general_translation_vi: Xen kẽ, xen nhau, luân phiên nhau, thay phiên
meanings: An alternate option is a different option.
examples: Taking the bus and driving to work are alternate ways to travel.

words.general_translation_vi: Có thể bị vi khuẩn làm cho thối rữa
meanings: Materials that are biodegradable break down naturally into substances that do not harm the environment.
examples: I use biodegradable compost to feed my garden.

words.general_translation_vi: Quá khứ và phân từ quá khứ của box
meanings: When something is boxed , it is inside a package.
examples: Justine brought a boxed gift to the birthday party.

meanings: If you choke on something, it stops you from breathing.
examples: The gum Malinda swallowed made her choke .

meanings: When something is convenient , it saves you time or effort.
examples: Walking through the park is a convenient way to exercise on the way to work.

meanings: To discard something is to throw it away.
examples: After repairing the window, discard any broken glass.

meanings: A dolphin is a large sea mammal that breathes air.
examples: Intelligent dolphins have learned to communicate with humans.

meanings: Ecologically means that something is done in a way that concerns living organisms and the environment.
examples: We planted our garden according to ecologically correct practices.

words.general_translation_vi: Có số mệnh, tiền định, không tránh được
meanings: Something that is fatal results in someone's death.
examples: Being shot by the attacker proved fatal to the victim.

words.general_translation_vi: Sự rơi vào, sự tác động vào
meanings: The number of times something happens is the incidence of the event.
examples: We need to increase the incidence of success in school.

words.general_translation_vi: Thành phố, (thuộc) đô thị, (thuộc) thị xã
meanings: Municipal means that something belongs to a city or local government.
examples: The municipal parking lot downtown can fit one hundred cars.

words.general_translation_vi: Sự dùng quá nhiều, sự lạm dụng
meanings: Overuse occurs when something is utilized too many times.
examples: Rochelle's overuse of the exercise bike caused the gears to break.

meanings: A pond is a freshwater body that is smaller than a lake.
examples: I learned to swim at the pond behind the recreation center.

words.general_translation_vi: Tái sinh (vật liệu đã dùng để dùng lại)
meanings: When you recycle an object, you use its parts to make something else.
examples: We recycle our newspapers so that they can be made into packing boxes.

meanings: An object that is reusable can be utilized over and over again.
examples: Saburo keeps his empty jelly jars because they are reusable for storing sewing supplies.

words.general_translation_vi: Quá khứ và phân từ quá khứ của stuff
meanings: When something is stuffed , it is pushed into a small space.
examples: The newspapers were all stuffed into the drawer.

meanings: A tragic event causes sadness because it might involve death or suffering.
examples: The entire community attended the memorial service for the victims of the tragic fire.

meanings: To utilize something is to use it for a specific purpose.
examples: The team can utilize the lab equipment to complete the experiment.

meanings: A whale is a very large mammal that lives in the ocean.
examples: We were surprised when a whale surfaced next to our boat.

meanings: An amateur is a person who does something for fun and isn't paid for it.
examples: The amateur took pictures just as well as the person who worked for money.

meanings: If something is ambiguous , it is not entirely clear.
examples: It's ambiguous as to whether a newborn baby looks like a girl or a boy.

meanings: If someone is anonymous , no one knows who he or she is.
examples: An anonymous donor gave a thousand dollars to the museum.

meanings: To attain something is to succeed at something or to get something you want.
examples: If you want to attain a healthy body, you must exercise every day.

meanings: Autonomy is another word for freedom or independence.
examples: In the 1800s, the people of India fought for autonomy from Britain.

meanings: A concession is something that one person gives up to another.
examples: China gave Hong Kong to Britain as a concession after the war.

words.general_translation_vi: Tình trạng suy tàn, tình trạng suy sụp, tình trạng sa sút (quốc gia, gia đình... )
meanings: Decay is the result of something slowly being broken down or destroyed naturally.
examples: The decay in the old building was obvious.

meanings: To dwell somewhere means to live there.
examples: Before he was a successful writer, Mark Twain dwelled in the city of Hannibal, Missouri.

words.general_translation_vi: Làm sáng tỏ, mở mắt cho (ai, về vấn đề gì... )
meanings: To enlighten someone is to teach them about something.
examples: Greek philosophers wanted to enlighten the people of Athens with their ideas.

words.general_translation_vi: Làm giàu, làm giàu thêm, làm phong phú
meanings: To enrich means to make someone rich or increase their wealth.
examples: Taxes on people's income can be used to enrich the government.

words.general_translation_vi: Hưng thịnh, thịnh vượng, phát đạt
meanings: To flourish means to do very well and be in an excellent condition.
examples: The Roman Empire flourished in Europe two thousand years ago.

meanings: Geometry is the study of shapes and how to measure them.
examples: If you want to be able to calculate the area of a circle, you must study geometry .

words.general_translation_vi: Chiếu ra một tia sáng yếu ớt, phát ra một ánh lập loè
meanings: To gleam means to sparkle and shine.
examples: The waves of the ocean would gleam every night at sunset.

meanings: Greed is wanting to have more of something than you need or should have.
examples: The story of King Midas is a story of greed .

words.general_translation_vi: Sự hài hoà, sự cân đối
meanings: Harmony is a feeling that everything is peaceful, balanced, and in agreement.
examples: The United Nations is struggling to bring peace and harmony to the world.

meanings: Indigenous means that something or someone exists naturally in an environment or area.
examples: The Pueblo people were an indigenous tribe in Arizona who lived in adobe homes.

words.general_translation_vi: Quyền lực pháp lý, quyền xử xét, quyền tài phán
meanings: Jurisdiction means the power or right to make judgments about the law and how it is upheld.
examples: We did not have jurisdiction to bring the criminal to trial.

meanings: A parade is a series of things or people that come or are shown one after another.
examples: This parade of elephants is part of an open-air exhibit to honor these majestic animals.

meanings: A statue is a three-dimensional work of art, usually made of clay, marble, or metal.
examples: The Venus de Milo is a famous ancient Greek statue .

meanings: A virgin is someone who has never had sex.
examples: The virgin goddess of the moon was known as Diana.

meanings: If something is abnormal , it is different from normal or average.
examples: I felt abnormal this morning, like I was sick.

meanings: If someone or something is absent , they are missing or not in the place they are expected to be.
examples: I was absent from school yesterday because I went on a trip with my father.

words.general_translation_vi: Gần kề, kế liền, sát ngay
meanings: When something is adjacent , it is next to or adjoining something else.
examples: My apartment is adjacent to a lovely park and playground.

words.general_translation_vi: Chính tả tiêu chuẩn ở Mỹ và Canada của aluminium
meanings: Aluminum is a chemical element that is a light silver-coloured metal.
examples: I used the aluminum foil to wrap the food.

words.general_translation_vi: Có thể dùng được, có thể áp dụng được, có thể ứng dụng được
meanings: If something is applicable to a person or thing, it is relevant to them.
examples: I discovered that my old password was no longer applicable to the website.

meanings: If something is artificial , it was not made naturally but mimics something natural.
examples: The artificial Christmas tree was made of plastic.

meanings: A bicycle is a two-wheeled vehicle powered by pedaling.
examples: I rode my bicycle down the mountain road.

words.general_translation_vi: Người môi giới, người mối lái buôn bán
meanings: To broker is to arrange or negotiate the details of something for others.
examples: The lawyer will broker our agreement.

meanings: A bureaucracy is a group of people who work together to help manage a large business or run a country.
examples: The members of the bureaucracy were flooded by too many petitions.

words.general_translation_vi: Sắp xếp, lắp đặt vật nào đó theo một cách để nó hoạt động theo ý muốn
meanings: To configure something means to set it up and arrange it.
examples: The engineer helped to configure my new computer.

meanings: To consolidate means to join or bring together into one thing.
examples: When we moved in together, we had to consolidate our belongings.

words.general_translation_vi: Sự tiện lợi, sự thuận lợi
meanings: If something is done for your convenience , it allows you to do something easily or without any trouble.
examples: I love the convenience of having a swimming pool in my back yard.

words.general_translation_vi: Lấy đi, khấu đi, trừ đi
meanings: To deduct means to subtract something.
examples: I had to deduct my expenses from my checkbook.

words.general_translation_vi: Tưởng rằng, nghĩ rằng, cho rằng, thấy rằng
meanings: To deem means to consider something.
examples: I deemed the ice cream to be very delicious.

words.general_translation_vi: Chủ doanh nghiệp, nhà thầu, chủ xí nghiệp
meanings: An entrepreneur is someone who starts a new business or organization in order to make money.
examples: The entrepreneur made a success out of his new business.

meanings: If something is evenly spread or spaced, it is divided equally into amounts, numbers, or values.
examples: Sprinkle the sugar evenly all over the cookies.

meanings: When something is fiscal , it is related to money or finances, especially that of a government or business.
examples: Did the company show fiscal growth this year?

meanings: A franchise is the right to sell another company's products or services in a particular area.
examples: The fast food restaurant has a franchise near my home.

meanings: If something is ideological , it is based on a system of beliefs or ideals, especially those that relate to a government or economy.
examples: The citizens of England had ideological differences about its government.

meanings: A robot is a machine that can do the work of a person and operates automatically or is controlled by a computer.
examples: I bought a robot that can clean the floor on its own.

meanings: An abbey is a house, or group of houses, where monks or nuns live.
examples: When the monk returned to the abbey , he went immediately to his bedroom.

meanings: If something is abundant , then it is available in large quantities.
examples: Cakes, cookies, and candy were so abundant that the child was very happy.

meanings: To adjoin something means to be next to or attached to something else.
examples: She can listen to her brother's conversations because her room adjoins his.

meanings: If something is ample , then it is enough or more than enough.
examples: There was an ample supply of oats to feed the horses.

meanings: If a place is arid , then it is hot and dry and gets very little or no rain.
examples: Not many plants grow in the arid desert.

meanings: A cathedral is an important, and often large and beautifully-built, church.
examples: The large cathedral is full of people on Sunday mornings.

meanings: A crisis is a difficult time when things are going to either get worse or better.
examples: The crisis was over and things returned to normal.

words.general_translation_vi: Lấy đi, cướp đi, tước đoạt, cướp đoạt
meanings: To deprive someone of something means to not let them have it.
examples: Because the child was bad, she was deprived of her dessert after dinner.

meanings: A drought is a long period of time in which little or no rain falls.
examples: After three months of drought , the vegetation and trees started dying.

words.general_translation_vi: Đủ điều kiện, đủ tư cách, thích hợp
meanings: If someone is eligible , then they are permitted to do or have something.
examples: Only people who bought tickets were eligible to win a prize.

meanings: To fast means to go without food or drink for a period of time.
examples: In her religion, they fast for five days and then have a big feast.

meanings: To grumble means to complain.
examples: He grumbled about having to work late on Friday.

words.general_translation_vi: Ở trong nước, ở sâu trong nước, về phía trong nước
meanings: If someone goes inland , they travel into the center of a country or land.
examples: The river curved inland near the campground.

meanings: Moisture is small drops of water in the air or on a surface.
examples: If you breathe on a window, moisture from your breath collects on the glass.

meanings: If something happens nonetheless , then it occurs despite some other thing.
examples: She tried to keep the dog out of the mud, but it got dirty nonetheless .

words.general_translation_vi: Một lời cam kết hoặc lời hứa long trọng mời gọi một vị thần, một người cai trị hoặc một thực thể khác (không nhất thiết phải có mặt) để chứng thực sự thật của một tuyên bố hoặc sự chân thành về mong muốn thực hiện hợp đồng hoặc lời hứa của một người
meanings: An oath is a formal, often public, promise.
examples: Judges must take an oath to be fair to everyone in court.

words.general_translation_vi: Cánh đồng, đồng cỏ, thảo nguyên
meanings: A prairie is a large flat area of grassland.
examples: The prairie was perfect for a farm because there were hills and trees.

words.general_translation_vi: Gồ ghề, lởm chởm, xù xì
meanings: If an area of land is rugged , then it is rocky and difficult to travel through.
examples: Their car couldn't make it far along the rugged roads.

words.general_translation_vi: Khan hiếm, ít có, thiếu, khó tìm
meanings: If something is scarce , then there is a very small amount of it.
examples: When gasoline was scarce , we rode our bike to school instead of driving.

meanings: To speculate means to guess about something.
examples: My sister looked at the sky and speculated that it would rain tomorrow.

words.general_translation_vi: Sống ở nước, mọc ở nước
meanings: If a plant or animal is aquatic , it lives or grows in water.
examples: The dolphin is an aquatic mammal.

meanings: The biosphere is the Earth's surface and atmosphere where there are living things.
examples: Birds, trees, and worms all thrive in the biosphere .

words.general_translation_vi: Kỳ quái, kỳ lạ, kỳ dị
meanings: When something is bizarre , it is very strange.
examples: My bizarre dreams make no sense to me when I am awake.

meanings: Celsius is a scale for measuring temperature.
examples: Water freezes at zero degrees Celsius .

meanings: If something is coarse , that means it has a rough texture.
examples: The coarse sweater made my skin itch.

meanings: A companion is a person that someone spends a lot of time with.
examples: I always walk to school with my companion Frank.

words.general_translation_vi: Phân loại, sắp đặt có hệ thống
meanings: To digest means to swallow food and pass it through the body.
examples: Allow some time for food to be digested before going swimming.

words.general_translation_vi: Thời gian, khoảng thời gian (tồn tại của một sự việc)
meanings: The duration of an event is the time during which it happens.
examples: The girls watched television for the duration of the evening.

meanings: Ecology is the study of the environment and living things.
examples: We study ecology to learn how to help improve the Earth.

meanings: A feat is an impressive or difficult achievement or action.
examples: The elephant's standing up on one leg was a feat .

meanings: If something is infinite , it has no limit or end.
examples: Many scientists believe that the universe is infinite .

meanings: The nucleus is the central part of an atom or cell.
examples: The nucleus is made up of many tiny particles.

meanings: A parasite is a tiny animal or plant that attaches to another animal to get food.
examples: The sick dog was covered in parasites .

meanings: When something is prominent , it is important and well known.
examples: Queen Victoria was a prominent person in history.

meanings: When something is repetitive , it is repeated many times and becomes boring.
examples: Working on an assembly line making cars every day is a repetitive job.

meanings: If something is reproductive , it is a living thing which can produce young.
examples: The reproductive system of a plant is simple.

words.general_translation_vi: Có chừng mực, vừa phải, điều độ
meanings: When a place is temperate , it never gets too hot or cold.
examples: In Peru, the weather is temperate and rarely gets too hot or cold.

meanings: Tolerance is the ability to accept something unfavorable or to allow the freedom of choice for others.
examples: Boxers have a high tolerance for pain.

meanings: To undergo an action means to have it happen to you.
examples: The cancer patient undergoes treatments twice a week.

meanings: When someone is vulnerable , they are weak and without protection.
examples: He felt very vulnerable when he was stranded in the desert.

words.general_translation_vi: Cổ xưa, cũ kĩ, cổ lỗ sĩ
meanings: If something is archaic , it is very old or outdated.
examples: To be competitive, we must update our archaic equipment.

meanings: Brass is a metal that is used to make musical instruments and ornaments.
examples: Brass is used to make musical instruments like trumpets.

meanings: Capitalism is an economic system where private companies make goods for profit.
examples: Most economies in the world today are based on capitalism .

meanings: A component is a part of a larger machine.
examples: Computers have many different components , so they are complicated to build.

words.general_translation_vi: Sự phụ thuộc, sự tuỳ thuộc, sự tuỳ theo
meanings: Dependence is a situation in which somebody relies on something else.
examples: Young children have a dependence on their parents.

words.general_translation_vi: Bớt, giảm, hạ bớt, giảm bớt
meanings: To diminish means to reduce or get smaller.
examples: As the economy got worse, my savings diminished .

words.general_translation_vi: Điều trở ngại, mặt hạn chế, mặt không thuận lợi
meanings: A drawback is a disadvantage.
examples: The drawback of having a car is that it is very expensive to maintain.

meanings: To impose means to interrupt or force your ideas on other people.
examples: He imposes on his wife every morning by expecting her to make his breakfast.

meanings: Industry is a kind of business that produces services or things for sale.
examples: The tourist industry is doing well all around the world.

meanings: Managerial describes something related to a manager or management.
examples: Nancy has a managerial position at the bank.

meanings: If something is medieval , it comes from the period between 650 and 1500 CE.
examples: We visited a castle that was built during medieval times.

words.general_translation_vi: Không dùng nữa, cổ xưa, cũ
meanings: If something is obsolete , it is not used anymore because something better exists.
examples: Since computers became inexpensive, typewriters have become obsolete .

words.general_translation_vi: Quá khứ và phân từ quá khứ của orient
meanings: When you are oriented towards something, you are faced in that direction.
examples: He is living a money- oriented lifestyle.

meanings: A peninsula is a large piece of land that is surrounded by the sea on three sides.
examples: The state of Florida is an example of a peninsula .

meanings: If a person has prestige , people admire or respect them.
examples: The young actress gained much prestige after she won an award.

words.general_translation_vi: Sự cân xứng, sự cân đối
meanings: A proportion is an amount that shows the link between the parts and the whole.
examples: Only a small proportion of the people in this town actually work here.

meanings: If something is radical , it is very new or different.
examples: The president is planning to make some radical changes to the law.

meanings: To refute something means to prove that it is false or incorrect.
examples: The bank manager has refuted the claims that he lied to his customers.

meanings: If something is spectacular , it looks or sounds very impressive.
examples: There was a spectacular fireworks display in the park at New Year.

meanings: To weave means to make cloth using horizontal and vertical threads.
examples: We saw a woman weave a blanket on our vacation to South America.

words.general_translation_vi: Nhân viên kế toán, người giữ sổ sách kế toán
meanings: An accountant is a person whose job is to keep financial accounts for a business.
examples: The accountant helped us keep track of our spending.

meanings: A capitalist is a business person who invests in trade and industry for profit.
examples: The capitalist invested in a factory that made wheat into cereal.

words.general_translation_vi: Sự coi khinh, sự coi thường, sự bỉ, sự khinh rẻ, sự khinh miệt
meanings: Contempt is the feeling of having no respect for something.
examples: The judge had contempt for the wicked criminal.

meanings: A crop is something produced by the land.
examples: I had a good crop of onions this year.

meanings: To dedicate oneself to something means to put a lot of time and effort into it.
examples: The nun dedicated herself to helping people in need.

meanings: A ditch is a narrow hole cut into the ground by a road or a field.
examples: When the car slid off of the road, it fell into the ditch .

words.general_translation_vi: Tổ chức kinh doanh, hãng, công ti
meanings: An enterprise is a company or business.
examples: My father owns an advertising enterprise .

words.general_translation_vi: Cấp tiền cho, bỏ vốn cho, tìm vốn cho
meanings: To finance someone or something means to provide money for them.
examples: The government financed the scientist's experiments with new weapons.

words.general_translation_vi: Lãnh đạm, thờ ơ, hờ hững, dửng dưng
meanings: When someone is indifferent toward something, they have a lack of interest in it.
examples: Lisa is indifferent toward school. She doesn't care what her final grades are.

meanings: To irrigate means to supply water to land so that crops can grow.
examples: In dry climates, it is important to irrigate fields of crops.

words.general_translation_vi: Làm tăng lên đến tột độ
meanings: To maximize something is to make it as great as possible in amount, size, or importance.
examples: You should exercise regularly to maximize a healthy lifestyle.

meanings: When something is monetary , it relates to money.
examples: A strong monetary policy is important for a country to be successful.

meanings: A precaution is an action that is meant to stop something bad from happening.
examples: As a precaution , you should put on a heavy coat before going out in cold weather.

meanings: Preliminary describes something that happens before a more important event.
examples: The runners must do well in the preliminary races to qualify for the final race.

meanings: To saturate something means to completely soak it with a liquid.
examples: The sponge was saturated with soapy water and dripped all over the floor.

meanings: The simplicity of something is the fact that it is easy to do or understand.
examples: We were able to find the house thanks to the simplicity of the directions.

meanings: To sow seeds means to plant them in the ground.
examples: He always sows his garden seeds in the springtime.

meanings: A spade is a tool used for digging.
examples: The gardener used her spade to make a hole for the new plant.

meanings: A tomato is a round red fruit, but usually eaten as a vegetable. It's often used in salads or pasta sauces.
examples: I like tomato sandwiches.

words.general_translation_vi: Chỉ những gì sắp diễn ra
meanings: When something is upcoming , that means it will happen in the near future.
examples: The kids were worried about their upcoming exam.

words.general_translation_vi: Nhân chủng học, nhân loại học, nhân học
meanings: Anthropology is the study of people, society, and culture.
examples: In anthropology class, I learned about simple tools that ancient cultures used.

words.general_translation_vi: Vỗ tay hoan nghênh, vỗ tay tán thưởng
meanings: To applaud means to clap in order to show approval.
examples: Everyone cheered and applauded Manny's efforts.

meanings: To appoint someone to a job means to give the job to them.
examples: Two students were appointed to help the scientists with their research.

meanings: When things are compatible , they work well or exist together successfully.
examples: Jan and Fred are too different. They will never be compatible .

meanings: Competence is the ability to do something well or effectively.
examples: The job was easy because the group had enough competence to do it well.

meanings: To confer with someone means to discuss something with them to make a decision.
examples: I will have to confer with my wife before I can purchase a new car.

words.general_translation_vi: Liên tục, liên tiếp, tiếp liền nhau
meanings: When things are consecutive , they happen one after another without interruption.
examples: The king ruled for ten consecutive years.

meanings: When something is crude , it is not exact or detailed but can still be useful.
examples: She drew crude hearts on the ground to show how much she loved him.

meanings: A cube is a solid object with six square surfaces that are all the same size.
examples: Please get me some ice cubes to put in my soda.

meanings: Feedback is comments to a person about how they are doing something.
examples: I asked my boss for feedback on my work.

words.general_translation_vi: Sự ngu dốt, sự không biết
meanings: Ignorance of something is lack of knowledge about it.
examples: When he failed the test, his ignorance of math was obvious.

meanings: When something is masculine , it is a quality or thing related to men.
examples: American football is usually considered a masculine sport.

words.general_translation_vi: Vật kỷ niệm, đài kỷ niệm, bia kỷ niệm, công trình kỷ niệm
meanings: A monument is a structure that is built to remind people of a person or event.
examples: A large monument was built to honor the brave soldiers.

meanings: When someone is muscular , they are very fit and strong.
examples: He exercised regularly so that his body could become muscular .

meanings: A person's posture is the manner in which they stand or sit.
examples: Your back will feel better if you improve your posture .

words.general_translation_vi: Đặt ở vị trí, đặt chỗ cho
meanings: To situate something means to place or build it in a certain place.
examples: The road was situated between the forest and the lake.

meanings: To supervise something means to make sure that it is done correctly.
examples: Allen supervised the construction workers to ensure everyone's safety.

meanings: Symmetry is the state of having two halves that are exactly the same.
examples: The artist made sure to use perfect symmetry when painting the butterfly.

words.general_translation_vi: Hiệu trống tập trung buổi tối
meanings: A tattoo is a design that is drawn permanently on the skin with needles.
examples: The surfer had tattoos on both his arms.

words.general_translation_vi: Sinh viên đại học chưa tốt nghiệp
meanings: An undergraduate is a student at a college who is studying for a bachelor's degree.
examples: She was excited to finish high school and enroll as an undergraduate in the fall.

words.general_translation_vi: Cung cấp thực phẩm, lương thực
meanings: To cater to someone means to provide them with all the things they need or want.
examples: Bill was too sick to get out of bed, so his nurse catered to his needs.

words.general_translation_vi: Ân cần, chu đáo, hay quan tâm tới người khác
meanings: When someone is considerate , they pay attention to the needs of others.
examples: The considerate boy gave his girlfriend a present to cheer her up when she was sad.

examples: The pathological liar could not even tell the truth about unimportant matters.

words.general_translation_vi: Hiện tượng, có tính chất hiện tượng
meanings: When something is phenomenal , it is unusually great.
examples: The child's ability to play the piano is nothing short of phenomenal .

meanings: A poll is a survey in which people give their opinions about important things.
examples: The poll showed that many people support the plan to stop gang violence.

words.general_translation_vi: Sự ăn năn, sự hối hận
meanings: Remorse is a strong feeling of sadness and regret.
examples: When I realized what I had done, I felt remorse for my actions.

meanings: Secrecy is the behavior of keeping things secret.
examples: The secrecy of the big organization made the government nervous.

meanings: To tackle something means to deal with it in a determined and efficient way.
examples: Such social problems need to be tackled right away.

meanings: A trance is a state where people seem asleep and have no control of themselves.
examples: The woman's powerful eyes often put men in a trance .

words.general_translation_vi: Người nhát gan, người nhút nhát
meanings: A coward is a person who lacks courage to do risky or dangerous things.
examples: A firefighter cannot be a coward . They have to be able to act quickly.

words.general_translation_vi: Gạch đi, xoá đi, bỏ đi
meanings: To delete something means to remove or erase written material.
examples: Several lines had been deleted from her speech.

meanings: If someone is earnest , then they are honest.
examples: The child was very earnest when she told her mother how she broke the dish.

words.general_translation_vi: Thuộc dân tộc, thuộc tộc người
meanings: If something is ethnic , then it is related to a group with a similar culture.
examples: Many sections of the city are home to different ethnic communities.

meanings: To exclude someone means to not accept them into a group.
examples: Carol was excluded from the contest because her friend was a judge.

meanings: If something is firsthand , then it is from an original source.
examples: If you want firsthand knowledge, ask someone who saw it.

words.general_translation_vi: Lưu loát, trôi chảy, viết lưu loát
meanings: If someone is fluent in a language, then they are able to speak it very well.
examples: She was so fluent in German that you'd have thought she was from Germany.

meanings: If something is imperial , then it is related to an empire.
examples: These old imperial coins were once used in the Roman Empire.

meanings: If something is inclusive , then it is open to all groups and people in society.
examples: A more inclusive event would have allowed children to attend.

meanings: A legislature is the section of a government that makes laws.
examples: The senator had served ten years in the national legislature .

meanings: If something is linguistic , then it is concerned with language.
examples: A linguistic way of studying culture focuses on words within that culture.

words.general_translation_vi: Dùng một ngôn ngữ mà thôi
meanings: If someone is monolingual , then they speak only one language.
examples: In today's global economy, being monolingual limits your opportunities.

meanings: Nationality is an identity based on the nation from which you come.
examples: His nationality is German, but he speaks French, Spanish, and Korean.

meanings: A patriot is someone who loves, supports, and defends their country.
examples: Every year, young patriots join their countries' militaries.

words.general_translation_vi: Theo đuổi, tiếp tục (việc nghiên cứu... ), tiến hành (cuộc điều tra... )
meanings: To prosecute someone means to take legal action against them.
examples: They were prosecuted for fishing in the river without a permit.

meanings: If something is racial , then it is related to a race or races.
examples: The differences between racial groups are physical characteristics and culture.

words.general_translation_vi: Theo nghi thức, trọng thể, long trọng
meanings: If something is solemn , then it is serious and honest.
examples: The professor preferred a solemn relationship between him and his students.

meanings: Solidarity is a union formed from common responsibilities or interests.
examples: All the citizens came together in a show of solidarity to create change.

words.general_translation_vi: Sự khéo xử, tài xử trí
meanings: Tact is the ability to avoid offending people when dealing with problems.
examples: Since both sides would not agree, it required someone with tact to make peace.

meanings: To undermine someone means to betray them or weaken their efforts or authority.
examples: The documents helped to undermine the workers' trust in their bosses' honesty.

words.general_translation_vi: Bắt ép, ép buộc, cưỡng ép, thúc ép
meanings: To constrain something means to limit its development.
examples: Jim cannot join us because he is constrained by previous plans.

meanings: A depot is a bus or train station.
examples: He waited for his mother to arrive at the depot .

meanings: To emulate people means to imitate them because they are greatly admired.
examples: As a small boy, he always tried to emulate his big brother.

meanings: The forefinger is the finger between one's thumb and middle finger.
examples: He shouted, "There it is!" and pointed with his forefinger .

words.general_translation_vi: Động từ chia ở ngôi thứ ba số ít của gut
meanings: The guts are all the organs inside a person or animal.
examples: The doctor can tell you every process that happens in one's guts .

meanings: When something is inherent , it is a natural part of something else.
examples: Sweating is an inherent bodily function when exercising.

words.general_translation_vi: Hăm doạ, đe doạ, doạ dẫm
meanings: To intimidate means to frighten others.
examples: My dad intimidates my friends whenever they visit.

meanings: A janitor is a person who makes repairs and takes care of a building.
examples: The school janitor cleaned up the messy cafeteria.

meanings: When something is moist , it is slightly wet.
examples: The ground is still moist from the rain last night.

meanings: Nope is an informal way of saying "no.".
examples: He asked if I had any money, and I had to say, " Nope ."

meanings: To prod means to push someone or something with a finger or pointed object.
examples: The bully prodded me in the chest with her finger.

meanings: A ransom is a sum of money paid to a kidnapper to set the person free.
examples: He kidnapped the prince and demanded $1 million as a ransom .

meanings: To restrain someone or something means to use physical strength to stop them.
examples: Mike restrained Allen from reaching the door.

words.general_translation_vi: Nước bọt, nước dãi, nước miếng
meanings: Saliva is the watery liquid in people's mouths that helps in digestion.
examples: The baby could not keep the saliva from dripping out of its mouth.

words.general_translation_vi: Xiên (thịt để nướng trong lò quay)
meanings: To spit means to force liquid from one's mouth.
examples: He emerged from the pool and spit water from his mouth.

words.general_translation_vi: Chạy nước rút, chạy hết tốc lực
meanings: To sprint means to run very fast over a short distance.
examples: The kids didn't want to be late to class, so they sprinted to the bus stop.

words.general_translation_vi: Sự làm cằn cỗi, sự làm còi cọc
meanings: A stunt is something that is done in order to get attention or publicity.
examples: The man jumped over the cars as a promotional stunt .

meanings: When people are tolerant , they are respectful of others' rights and beliefs.
examples: The tolerant leader thought that everyone was equal regardless of race.

words.general_translation_vi: Ma hút máu, ma cà rồng
meanings: A vampire is a fictional monster that sleeps in a coffin and sucks people's blood.
examples: The vampire snuck up on the woman and bit her neck.

words.general_translation_vi: Há miệng, toác ra, mở ra (đồ vật)
meanings: To yawn means to open one's mouth wide and breathe in air.
examples: The child yawned and stretched her arms before going to bed for the night.

words.general_translation_vi: Gần kề, kế bên, tiếp giáp, bên cạnh, sát nách
meanings: If something is adjoining , it is next to or joined with a building or room.
examples: I couldn't sleep because the people in the adjoining room were loud.

meanings: To allege something is to say that it is true without offering proof.
examples: The little girl had alleged that her older brother hid her favorite doll.

words.general_translation_vi: Khung tò vò, cửa tò vò
meanings: An arch is a curved opening formed under a structure such as a bridge or doorway.
examples: The arch of the bridge was not high enough for the tall boat to pass underneath.

words.general_translation_vi: Tập hợp, tụ tập, nhóm họp
meanings: To assemble means to get together in one place.
examples: The parents assembled to discuss ways to improve their children's education.

meanings: A casualty is a person killed or injured in a war or an accident.
examples: The only casualty in the car accident was a woman who broke her arm.

words.general_translation_vi: Dựng đứng thẳng, đặt đứng thẳng
meanings: To erect something means to build it.
examples: The king erected two towers on the north and south sides of his castle.

meanings: If something is foul , then it is very unpleasant.
examples: He wouldn't let his dog drink from the water because it had a foul smell.

meanings: A hectare is a unit of measure equal to 10,000 square meters.
examples: His family farm covered many hectares .

words.general_translation_vi: Làm cao lên, làm cao hơn, nâng cao
meanings: To heighten an emotion means to increase the intensity of it.
examples: The pleasant music heightened their enjoyment of the wonderful dinner.

meanings: Hospitality is friendly behavior and entertainment, shown to guests or strangers.
examples: The travelers were amazed at the hospitality given them by the hotel's staff.

meanings: A mansion is a large and expensive home.
examples: The mansion had thirty bedrooms, two kitchens, and a pool.

meanings: To outnumber a group means to have a greater number than it.
examples: The girls outnumbered the boys at the school by four to one.

meanings: If someone is overjoyed , then they are extremely happy.
examples: He was overjoyed by the news of his promotion.

meanings: A pasture is an area of land covered with grass for animals to use as food.
examples: The sheep were taken to a pasture where there was more grass.

words.general_translation_vi: Sự cầu xin, sự thỉnh cầu
meanings: A petition is a written request asking an authority to do something.
examples: The citizens all signed a petition asking the mayor to repair the sidewalks.

meanings: To renovate a building means to repair it, or to build new structures on it.
examples: The old fire station was renovated into an apartment building.

words.general_translation_vi: Đọc lại, xem lại, duyệt lại, xét lại
meanings: To revise something means to change it, or update it to make it better.
examples: When the editor discovered certain facts were wrong, he revised the book.

meanings: A slab is a large, thick, flat piece of stone, concrete, metal, or wood.
examples: I looked at various slabs of stone to decorate my house.

words.general_translation_vi: Nền đất cao, chỗ đất đắp cao
meanings: A terrace is an open area that is connected to a house or an apartment.
examples: In the afternoons, she liked to sit on the terrace and check her email.

meanings: Turf is a section of grass and the dirt in which it grows.
examples: After the game, the turf looked ragged.

meanings: If something is analogous to another thing, then it is like it in certain ways.
examples: The relationship with his teacher was analogous to that of a son and mother.

meanings: Binoculars are a device used for seeing things that are far away.
examples: He could see the ship on the horizon only if he used his binoculars .

meanings: The bulk of something is its size.
examples: The large elephant moved its bulk with legs as strong as tree trunks.

meanings: If something comprises something else, it consists of or is made up of it.
examples: Our school's football team is mostly comprised with seniors.

meanings: To depict something means to show or portray it, often using art.
examples: The statue's face depicted the general's determination and courage.

meanings: If something is dual , then it is made up of two parts.
examples: The room had a dual function. It was a living room, but at night it was a bedroom.

meanings: Fahrenheit is a temperature scale where water freezes at 32° and boils at 212°.
examples: When the temperature dropped to 32° Fahrenheit , it started snowing.

words.general_translation_vi: Thực hiện, hoàn thành, làm trọn (nhiệm vụ...)
meanings: To fulfill something means to achieve or finish it.
examples: The professor did not fulfill his promise not to miss a single class.

meanings: A grove is a small group of trees.
examples: All the trees in this grove are apple trees.

meanings: Ore is the raw form of rock or material from which a valuable metal is taken.
examples: The factory melted the ore and used it to make iron products.

words.general_translation_vi: Vùng định cư xa xôi hẻo lánh, vùng xa xôi hẻo lánh
meanings: The outback is the wild inland region of Australia where very few people live.
examples: Many Australian farmers use the outback to raise cattle.

meanings: To outweigh something means to exceed it in value, amount, or importance.
examples: Finding a warm place to sleep outweighed the need to find something to eat.

meanings: A paradox is a true statement or real event that seems illogical.
examples: The paradox of her work was that the less she worked, the more she got done.

meanings: A pier is a structure that extends into a body of water.
examples: If you want to catch bigger fish, then go to the far end of the pier .

meanings: A shortcut is a route that is shorter than the main route.
examples: We got to the house early because we took a shortcut through the forest.

meanings: A tariff is a tax or fee paid on certain imports or exports.
examples: Our tariff on imported wool makes foreign wool more expensive.

meanings: A thermometer is a device that measures temperature.
examples: The thermometer outside the window indicated that it was a hot day today.

meanings: To tilt something means to tip it into a sloping position.
examples: She tilted her glass and almost spilled some of the wine inside.

meanings: If a statement is vice versa , then its two main ideas are switched with one another.
examples: Students learn from their teachers, and vice versa .

words.general_translation_vi: Chỗ ở, ni ở (của người nào)
meanings: The whereabouts of someone or something is the place where they are.
examples: The police looked for the lost dog, but its whereabouts were still unknown.
